parsed.post: The recent attempt to increase the learning rate resulted in a significant regression (1.137677). It seems the model is becoming unstable at the current learning rate with the existing warmup/decay. Reverting to the previous best (1.059110) and focusing on architectural capacity instead.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 128 to boost model capacity and test if higher width improves validation bits per byte within the 5-minute budget, while keeping the stable learning rate and warmup settings.
